source_text: Iudas vulpem pusillam habuit in amore pecuniae; Dominus loculos commisit ut cupiditas sanaretur, sed libertas arbitrii medelis non usus est. Sic cogitatio mala adulta ad peccati effectum tendit.
pass_a_gloss: Judas fox little had in love of-money; Lord money-bags entrusted that greed might-be-healed, but freedom of-will of-remedies not made-use. So thought evil grown-up toward of-sin effect tends.
pass_b_english: Judas had a little fox in love of money; the Lord entrusted him with the money-bags that greed might be healed, but free will did not use the remedies. So an evil thought, once grown, tends toward the deed of sin.
